title: NICKEBO door
description: NICKEBO door, matte gray-green, 18x60" NICKEBO fronts in timeless grey-green have clean straight lines and a smooth, matt surface made of durable foil. The simple design feels modern and harmonious and is easy to personalize. You can choose to mount the door on the right or left side.
features: Complete with UTRUSTA 110° hinge with built-in damper for kitchen, 2-pack, sold separately.
Requires a knob or a handle
May be completed with NICKEBO cover panels, plinth and decorative strip in grey-green.
Extra love and care may be needed to remove smudges and fingerprints from the beautiful matte surface.
materialAndCare: Main parts: Particleboard; Frontside: Plastic foil (min. 70% recycled); Backside: Plastic foil; Edge: Plastic edging, Plastic edging
